source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: Plus sign is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide what the terms of an expression are' is answered as plus sign rather than term — on the item about Decide what the terms of an expression are..

mx.teacher_note: Plus sign is what produces term, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide what the terms of an expression are..

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is term because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Decide what the terms of an expression are' as the operative test — on the item about Decide what the terms of an expression are..

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: term is settled by running 'Decide whether a multiplication over a sum or difference can be': The multiple of a sum or difference is the same as the sum or difference of the multiples — on the item about Decide what the terms of an expression are..

intelligence.enrichment: Terms are the parts of an expression separated by plus signs; to identify terms, rewrite each subtraction as addition of the inverse, so 83 - 14 has terms 83 and -14.
